title: Make the next action clear
prompt:
Handoff: integration is blocked by a missing test account. Priya owns providing it by 2026-10-20. Validation resumes after the account is provided; validation is not complete.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. status: blocked or complete; blocker: string; owner: string; due_date: string; next_action: provide_test_account or report_success.
remediation_hints: A useful handoff names the blocker, owner, deadline and action needed to resume.
